description:
Manages IRIS system alert state. Single supported action:

- **reset**: Calls `$SYSTEM.Monitor.Clear()` to reset the alert counter and system state. The `alerts.log` file is NOT truncated — historical entries remain on disk for audit. `iris_metrics_alerts` will re-populate active alerts on the next poll if conditions persist.

Actions NOT available (deferred to Epic 13 — IRIS has no native API for either):
- `clear` (remove a specific alert by index)
- `acknowledge` (mark an alert as seen without clearing the counter)

action.description: Action to perform. Only 'reset' is supported: calls $SYSTEM.Monitor.Clear() to clear the alert counter and system state.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_alerts_manage
title: Manage System Alerts
